hooks.command: powershell -NoProfile -Command "$inc='portfolio_analyzer_revere|node -e| npm | npx |easyocr|tools[\/]|test[\/]|_rerun|qmg|scanVideo|whiteboard_worker'; $exc='mcp|vscode|playwright|uv.cache|site-packages|extensions'; $a=Get-CimInstance Win32_Process | Where-Object { $_.Name -match '^(node|python|pythonw)' }; $p=@($a | Where-Object { $_.CommandLine -and ($_.CommandLine -match $inc) -and ($_.CommandLine -notmatch $exc) }); $t=[Console]::In.ReadToEnd(); if ($t -match 'npm (run )?test') { [Console]::Error.WriteLine('BLOCKED: npm test launches ~40 node processes at once. Ask the user to run it themselves.'); exit 2 }; $n=@($p | Where-Object { $_.Name -match '^node' }).Count; $y=@($p | Where-Object { $_.Name -match '^python' }).Count; if (($n -ge 6) -or ($y -ge 4)) { [Console]::Error.WriteLine('BLOCKED process-count hook: project node=' + $n + ' project python=' + $y + ' already running (caps: node 6, python 4). The ~30 harness MCP/VSCode processes are NOT counted. Let one finish first.'); exit 2 }"
